source.title: P0 OWNER OVERRIDE — Pause Olight; initiate EPOCH vendor and 1250A-ES Shopify pilot
source.body:
# OWNER DIRECTIVE — October 13, 2026
**Authority:** current owner direction supersedes older Olight marketing and bundle priorities.
**OS1 work state:** P0 ACTIVE — EPOCH vendor intake + exact first SKU.
**Olight work state:** PAUSED / OWNER HOLD. No new Olight content, listings, promotions, Black Friday bundles, campaign builds, vendor outreach, or nonessential Olight development until explicit owner release. Leave live products and orders intact; do not neglect paid-order or warranty obligations. Preserve Peter's finished source work and existing accepted records; do not delete, revert or publish them.

## Exact first EPOCH item
- Source: https://www.epochbatteries.com/products/12v-50ah-marine-lithium-battery
- Manufacturer SKU: **1250A-ES**, 12V 50Ah Essential Series marine/deep-cycle LiFePO4, Bluetooth, 640Wh; NOT cranking rated and NOT heated.
- **Shopify DRAFT created October 13** using native Shopify vendor **Epoch Batteries**; original exact SKU, public spec-based copy, no synthetic stock, no product media imported without rights proof, no publication.
- SKU-specific MAP, merchant selling price, fulfillment/shipping/available stock, dealer costs, product media rights, and final customer orderability remain subject to private source evidence and review; confidential dealer data must NOT enter this public issue.
- Do not confuse EPOCH 1250A-ES with other EPOCH 50Ah marine/heated/IP67 models.

## One bounded OS1 → OS3 next process
1. Keep an EPOCH private vendor account profile: approved dealer relationship, contact and portal reference, exact tier/commercial schedule in PRIVATE storage only, official MAP policy, returns/warranty terms, origin and dropship model, channel/destination rights.
2. Stage exact EPOCH vendor/SKU/COMMERCIAL/EVIDENCE/SOP records in existing OS3 v0.3.1 master on owner host via supported private import; preserve source hashes, dates, policy approval boundary, and original current SKU identity. **No OS3 private-master import or local execution claimed by this issue.**
3. Verify portal-linked stock/order acceptance, exact Tier-appropriate SKU buy price, parcel/dropship fees, tax-exemption state and authorized marketing media for quantity one, Lower-48 delivery.
4. Qualify the existing unpublished Shopify draft for sourcing/shipping/MAP checkout behavior; exact manual fulfillment location and supplier receipt/readback must be recorded before publishing or allowing orders.
5. Only after this EPOCH onboarding milestone and explicit owner direction should any Olight work resume. SOK existing paid customer and freight commitments continue independently.

**Assignments:** OS1 management controls priority; Peter retains finished Olight work in paused state, and can own ongoing supplier operations without duplicate work. OS3 handles typed bounded SKU/vendor and listing execution only under its existing authorization controls.

**No external email, vendor/contact outreach, Shopify publication, eBay write, discount, freight booking or other customer-facing mutation is authorized by this issue.**
